title: Search Autocomplete
subtitle: Pre-compute the answers per prefix, and pay for freshness only where it matters
motto: Answer before they finish typing, from an answer you made earlier
keyInsight: A 290,000-requests-a-second suggestion service needs 21 servers if every keystroke reaches the trie and 3 once debounce and caches take the load, but a trending event misses both the cache and the 15-minute-old trie, so freshness and capacity have to be bought separately.

decisions.title: Show the raw load first
decisions.description: The first frame sends every keystroke to the trie so the debounce and cache layers are justified by the server count they remove.
decisions.alternatives: Starting from the layered design would hide how much work each layer saves.

decisions.title: Fail on a trending spike
decisions.description: The failure frame drops the cache hit rate and leaves the trie stale at once, since a new query breaks both defences together.
decisions.alternatives: Testing only steady traffic would show the cache working and miss the case people notice.

decisions.title: Price freshness and capacity separately
decisions.description: The trade-off frame reports staleness falling from the batch interval to 2 minutes and the server count needed for the spike, with the total cost against v1.
decisions.alternatives: Adding servers alone fixes the load but leaves suggestions stale for a whole batch interval.
